author: poojaranjan
content:
With the help of the ACD Bot integrated into the ethereum/pm repository, the EIPsInsight team is already posting meeting summaries and key decisions to the [ECH Discord](https://discord.gg/9xuzuEacvk). 

I’d suggest adding a dedicated #notes channel to this server and using a webhook to automatically publish updates from all Ethereum protocol meetings. This functionality is already implemented and working well in the ECH Discord. I’d be happy to set it up and maintain it if there’s interest.

author: draganrakita
content: Forkcast has that too https://forkcast.org/calls/acde/242/ (And we do it internally) but imo human needs to make sense of it. For example i guess this is really confusing for people that were not listening `Platåberget testnet: public-facing named testnet (CNAME for devnet-8); ~1 week after launch before fork; separate NFT devnets for internal testing continue`

author: poojaranjan
content:
Since both platforms use the same ACD Bot, the automated output would be identical. However, I agree there’s real value in having a human-reviewed meeting summary. Zoom already generates AI meeting summaries immediately after each call, which could be reviewed, refined, and then published here.

Would the meeting facilitators prefer to own that process? If not, ECH used to do that in past and would be happy to take responsibility for reviewing, publishing, and maintaining those AI summaries.

author: poojaranjan
content: Additionally, the ACD Bot also publishes meeting summaries and next steps on EthMagicians (for example: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/all-core-devs-execution-acde-242-july-30-2026/29043/3). But, I think those summaries would also benefit from a quick human review 🙂

author: wolovim
content: that line's clunky and included pari's joke 😅 will clean it up. i maintain acdbot and treat its output as a baseline for forkcast - gets a quick round of QA before it goes out, but priority is making it available quickly and making it obvious to the viewer which convos they'd be interested in, rather than comprehensive outcomes. i see the value of mario's summaries meeting another need, will play with some ideas.

author: wolovim
content:
will keep noodling on it, but v1 of "detailed notes" are now included as a summary tab, e.g., https://forkcast.org/calls/acde/242?summary=notes

these are long-winded if fully expanded, but intended to let you get away with not attending/watching the call. feedback welcome, will iterate. current plan is to do a similar light QA round before publishing, but itll remain mostly automated. whoever wants to do manual high-touch, distilled summaries, knock yourself out 🙂
